data.name: Jiaul
data.gender_notes: Jiaul is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Jiaul is the name of a goddess who symbolizes wealth, prosperity, and good fortune. She is often depicted carrying a lotus in her hand and is revered by many for her blessings of abundance and success. The name Jiaul carries the meaning “Goddess of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jiaul usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Jiaul belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jiaul total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

historical_references.reference: The name Jiaul is mentioned in the Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic. Jiaul is a charioteer of Bhishma Pitamaha, the grandsire of the Kuru dynasty. Bhishma lies on a bed of arrows, waiting for the right time to fight his final battle.

Another mention of the name Jiaul is found in the Puranas, a set of 18 Hindu texts. Jiaul is a king of the Vidarbha region, who is said to have donated a large amount of land to the god Shiva for the construction of a temple.
